item.frontiers.raw_cobalt.tip: Can be smelted in a furnace to create a cobalt ingot.
item.frontiers.brimtan_ingot.tip: A hot-to-the-touch ingot which can be used to craft tools made from this material. Created by smelting ore in a furnace.
item.frontiers.brimtan_cluster.tip: Can be smelted in a furnace to create a brimtan nugget.
item.frontiers.brimtan_nugget.tip: Created by smelting Brimtan Clusters in a furnace. Can be crafted into a Brimtan Ingot.
item.frontiers.diamond_chunk.tip: Crafted from a diamond. Can be used to craft unique tools or armor. It cannot become a full diamond again.
item.frontiers.raw_frostite.tip: Obtained from melted frostite ore. Can be smelted in a furnace to create a frostite ingot.
item.frontiers.void_diamond.tip: Use these to create some of the strongest, most powerful weapons and armor in the world.
item.frontiers.black_emerald.tip: A rare variant of Emerald. Can be used to craft rare tools.
item.frontiers.frostite_ingot.tip: A freezing-cold ingot obtained through a tedious process. Created by smelting ore in a furnace.
item.frontiers.cursed_tablet.tip: Used to craft a Curse Altar, or can be used with a Curse Altar to remove all curse enchantments on a single item.
item.frontiers.obsidian_casing.tip: Crafted with Obsidian and Diamonds. Can be used to upgrade Golden tools in a Smithing Table.
item.frontiers.cobalt_fishing_rod.tip: Used to catch a wider variety of fish and items.
item.frontiers.obsidian_upgrade_smithing: Can be combined with Golden tools and an Obsidian Casing to give the gear an Obsidian tip.
item.frontiers.heart_of_the_warden.tip: Dropped by the Warden. Using it on a Sculk Catalyst allows for the collection of a very exotic ore.
item.frontiers.shulker_residue.tip: Collected by smashing a Shulker's bullet. Can be used to make potions, bricks and other goods.
item.frontiers.withered_essence.tip: Dropped by the Wither, used in crafting a variety of useful items.
item.frontiers.onyx_bone.tip: Collected by killing a Wither skeleton. Can be used to craft necro weave.
item.frontiers.necro_weave.tip: Crafted from Onyx Bones and Wool. Can be crafted into armor.
item.frontiers.ancient_rose_seed.tip: Grows into an Ancient Rose and is obtained by letting a Sniffer sniff it out of the ground.
item.frontiers.ectoplasm.tip: Dropped by Ghasts when they die. Mainly used to craft Mourning gold ingots.
item.frontiers.mourning_gold_ingot.tip: Crafted with Gold Ingots, Ectoplasm and Quartz. Can be used to make unique tools.
item.frontiers.marshmallow.tip: Can be consumed extremely fast. Restores 0.5 §f🍖§r, or can be cooked on a campfire (or furnace, if you hate fun).
item.frontiers.roasted_marshmallow.tip: Restores 1 §f🍖§r. Can be consumed extremely fast.
item.frontiers.invoke_shard.tip: A magical shard that can be crafted into Totems of Undying & other powerful items.
item.frontiers.nacre_brick.tip: Baked from Shulker residue in a furnace.
item.frontiers.hardened_slime.tip: Crystallized slime found rarely underground. Can be used to craft Slime Shoes.
item.frontiers.levi_roll.tip: Restores 1.5 §f🍖§r. Eating this can cause you to momentarily levitate.
item.frontiers.pomegranate.tip: Restores 0.5 §f🍖§r. Has a chance to not be consumed on use.
item.frontiers.truffle.tip: A very rare mushroom obtained by letting a Sniffer sniff it out of Mycelium. Can also pacify Hoglins, preventing them from becoming Zoglins.
item.frontiers.truffle_potato_puff.tip: Restores 2 §f🍖§r and provides moderate saturation. Can be eaten more quickly than most other foods.
item.frontiers.truffle_oil.tip: Restores 0.5 §f🍖§r, but is extremely saturating. Drinking this can cause Hunger, however
item.frontiers.apple_of_enlightenment.ti: An extremely rare food item. Permanently adds 2 §f💖§r to your maximum health when first eaten, changing your health's appearance (§f💗§r).
item.frontiers.lightning_in_a_bottle.tip: Created when lightning strikes a brewing stand with an attached lightning rod, as long as it contains glass bottles. Can be thrown or used in crafting.
item.frontiers.purified_end_crystal.tip: A variant of the End Crystal that can be used to further power up Enchanting Tables. Does not explode when hit, instead dropping itself.
item.frontiers.end_crystal_shard.tip: Dropped by destroyed End Crystals. Can be used in crafting.
item.frontiers.raw_verdinite.tip: Can be smelted in a furnace to create a verdinite ingot.
item.frontiers.tablet_fragment.tip: Can be used to craft a Cursed Tablet.
item.frontiers.tome_of_fangs.tip: A book that summons a line of Evoker Fangs in the direction you're facing. Using it at your feet summons a circle of fangs instead.
item.frontiers.ravager_tooth.tip: Dropped by Ravagers. Can be used in crafting.
item.frontiers.incense.tip: The pure essence of anger, dropped by Vexes. Can be used in crafting.
item.frontiers.onyx_meal.tip: Used to instantly grow Nether Wart and Warped Wart, and will destroy nearby grasses when used on Grass Blocks. Can be used to craft Black Dye.
item.frontiers.void_pearl.tip: Consumed on use, allowing access to a secure personal storage. Can be used to craft an Ender Chest.
item.frontiers.necro_weave_helmet.tip: Gives the user 1 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set enhances the power of bows.
item.frontiers.necro_weave_chestplate.ti: Gives the user 3 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set enhances the power of bows.
item.frontiers.necro_weave_leggings.tip: Gives the user 2.5 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set enhances the power of bows.
item.frontiers.necro_weave_boots.tip: Gives the user 1 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set enhances the power of bows.
item.frontiers.frostite_helmet.tip: Gives the user 2.5 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set provides immunity against specific effects.
item.frontiers.frostite_chestplate.tip: Gives the user 5 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set provides immunity against specific effects.
item.frontiers.frostite_leggings.tip: Gives the user 4 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set provides immunity against specific effects.
item.frontiers.frostite_boots.tip: Gives the user 2.5 §f👘§r when worn. Wearing a full set provides immunity against specific effects.
item.frontiers.plate_helmet.tip: Gives the user 1 §f💖§r when worn, and increases mining capabilities.
item.frontiers.plate_chestplate.tip: Gives the user 2 §f💖§r when worn, and increases mining capabilities.
item.frontiers.plate_leggings.tip: Gives the user 1.5 §f💖§r when worn, and increases mining capabilities.
item.frontiers.plate_boots.tip: Gives the user 0.5 §f💖§r when worn, and increases mining capabilities.
item.frontiers.slime_shoes.tip: Gives the user 0.5 §f👘§r when worn, and causes the wearer to bounce when hitting the ground.
item.frontiers.unfinished_core.tip: Found in Bastion Remnants. Must be combined with 4 unique Core Plates to make a Reactive Core.
item.frontiers.reactive_core.tip: Crafted from an Unfinished Core and the 4 unique Core Plates. Used to craft a Strange Core.
item.frontiers.depths_core_plate.tip: A Core Plate made from rare ores. Used in crafting a Reactive Core.
item.frontiers.frontal_core_plate.tip: A Core Plate made from exotic ores. Used in crafting a Reactive Core.
item.frontiers.everseed.tip: Found in Jungle Temples. Grows into an Evertree.
item.frontiers.pitch_ingot.tip: A strange ingot which can be used to craft tools made from this material. Created by smelting ore in a furnace.
item.frontiers.copper_bow.tip: A stronger version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.iron_bow.tip: A stronger version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.diamond_bow.tip: A stronger version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.netherite_bow.tip: A stronger version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.echo_bow.tip: A faster version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.verdinite_bow.tip: A stronger version of a wooden Bow.
item.frontiers.tower_key_fragment.tip: Can be used to craft a Tower Key.
item.frontiers.guardian_slice.tip: Restores 1.5 §f🍖§r. Removes Mining Fatigue on consumption.
item.frontiers.elder_guardian_slice.tip: Restores 2 §f🍖§r. Removes Mining Fatigue on consumption.
item.frontiers.cooked_guardian_slice.tip: Restores 3 §f🍖§r. Removes Mining Fatigue on consumption.
item.frontiers.cooked_elder_guardian_sli: Restores 4 §f🍖§r. Removes Mining Fatigue on consumption.
item.frontiers.tower_key.tip: Can be used at a Tower Vault to unlock it.
item.frontiers.warped_wart.tip: Used in advanced potion brewing. This can be found naturally growing in Bastion Remnants. It can also be planted on Soul Sand.
item.frontiers.raw_vivulite.tip: Can be smelted in a furnace to create a vivulite ingot.
item.frontiers.pale_prismarine_shard.tip: Dropped by Elder Guardians. Can be used in crafting alternate colors of Prismarine blocks.
item.frontiers.totem_of_avarice.tip: Dying with this in your inventory will allow you to keep your items. Consumed on use.
item.frontiers.ball.tip: A recreational item that can be thrown around.
item.frontiers.bouncy_ball.tip: A recreational item that can be thrown around. Bounces off of blocks up to 4 times.
item.frontiers.soul.tip: A important resource dropped by stronger enemies.
item.frontiers.warp_arrow.tip: Teleports the user to wherever it lands, at the cost of some health.
item.frontiers.warp_arrow_arrowhead.tip: Used on a Fletching Table to create Warp Arrows.
item.frontiers.subzero_arrow.tip: Immediately freezes the victim as if they were standing in Powder Snow.
item.frontiers.subzero_arrow_arrowhead.t: Used on a Fletching Table to create Subzero Arrows.

Used on a Fletching Table to create Dynamite Arrows.

item.frontiers.music_disc_diaphragm.tip: Can be played in a jukebox.
item.frontiers.chest_key.tip: Can be used on a Personal Chest that you own to give its assigned player access to it.
item.frontiers.brimtan_helmet_upgrade_sm: Can be combined with a Vivulite Helmet and the correct Brimtan Shell to make a Brimtan Helmet.
item.frontiers.brimtan_chestplate_upgrad: Can be combined with a Vivulite Chestplate and the correct Brimtan Shell to make a Brimtan Chestplate.

item.frontiers.brimtan_boots_upgrade_smi: Can be combined with Vivulite Boots and the correct Brimtan Shell to make Brimtan Boots.
item.frontiers.brimtan_tool_upgrade_smit: Can be combined with a Vivulite Tool and the correct Brimtan Shell to make a Brimtan Tool.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_sword.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Sword on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_shovel.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Shovel on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_axe.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Axe on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_pickaxe.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Pickaxe on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_hoe.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Hoe on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.brimtan_shell_knife.tip: Can be combined with a Vivulute Knife on a Smithing Table, provided you have the template.
item.frontiers.cobalt_shield.tip: Stronger than a regular shield, has less disable time when hit with an axe, and knocks melee attacks further back.
item.frontiers.pale_trident.tip: A more powerful Trident crafted from Elder Guardian Spines.
item.frontiers.elder_guardian_spine.tip: Can be used to craft a Pale Trident.
item.frontiers.experiwinkle_bulb.tip: Can be planted on farmland to grow an Experiwinkle. It cannot be bonemealed.
item.frontiers.cobalt_horse_armor.tip: A special type of Armor that can be equipped to a horse. Provides 7 §f👘§r.
item.frontiers.verdinite_horse_armor.tip: A special type of Armor that can be equipped to a horse. Provides 8.5 §f👘§r.
item.frontiers.vivulite_horse_armor.tip: A special type of Armor that can be equipped to a horse. Provides 10 §f👘§r.
item.frontiers.frost_bone.tip: Collected by killing a Stray. Can be crafted into snow melt.
item.frontiers.snow_melt.tip: Will melt snow layers in a small radius.
item.frontiers.bait.tip: Can be thrown into water to drastically increase the chances of catching fish in that area.
item.frontiers.message_in_a_bottle.tip: Can hold a small amount of text.
item.frontiers.bottled_message.tip: A note from an anonymous source. Throwing it into open water in an Ocean biome will allow it to be fished up in any Ocean biome.
item.frontiers.mana_bottle.tip: When thrown, it drops Mana Orbs which increase your mana meter when collected.
item.frontiers.spawner_chunk.tip: A piece of a Monster Spawner. Can be used to craft a Monster Bakery.
item.frontiers.golden_egg.tip: Laid by chickens when fed a Golden Nugget. Can be consumed to earn extra Experience from mobs.
item.frontiers.obsidian_axe_broken.tip: A broken Obsidian Axe. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.obsidian_sword_broken.tip: A broken Obsidian Sword. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.obsidian_shovel_broken.ti: A broken Obsidian Shovel. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.obsidian_hoe_broken.tip: A broken Obsidian Hoe. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.obsidian_pickaxe_broken.t: A broken Obsidian Pickaxe. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.obsidian_knife_broken.tip: A broken Obsidian Knife. Can be repaired with Obsidian on an Anvil.
item.frontiers.reinforced_shears.tip: Used to obtain wool from sheep and to harvest Cobwebs, Leaves, and Seagrass blocks.
item.frontiers.brimtan_helmet.tip: Gives the user 3.5 §f👘§r when worn, and glows in the dark.
item.frontiers.brimtan_chestplate.tip: Gives the user 6 §f👘§r when worn, and glows in the dark.
item.frontiers.brimtan_leggings.tip: Gives the user 5 §f👘§r when worn, and glows in the dark.
item.frontiers.brimtan_boots.tip: Gives the user 3.5 §f👘§r when worn, and glows in the dark.
block.frontiers.cobalt_ore.tip: Can be mined with a Netherite pickaxe or better once the Wither has been defeated, otherwise it disintegrates. Can be smelted in a furnace to produce cobalt ingots.
block.frontiers.cobalt_block.tip: A compact way of storing Cobalt.
block.frontiers.deepslate_cobalt_ore.tip: Can be mined with a Netherite pickaxe or better once the Wither has been defeated, otherwise it disintegrates. Can be smelted in a furnace to produce cobalt ingots.
block.frontiers.frostite_ore.tip: Can be mined with a cobalt pickaxe or better - but only when enchanted with Silk Touch. Must be melted by a light source to collect the raw frostite within.
block.frontiers.glowing_obsidian.tip: A special glowing variant of Obsidian obtained when a Strange Core converts Obsidian. Creates a Crags portal in the Nether, or can be used as decoration.
block.frontiers.strange_core.tip: A core with the ability to terraform its surroundings. Part of a structure - 5 blackstone in a plus shape, 4 Mourning Gold blocks in the corners of the plus, 4 blackstone above those, the core in the center, then another blackstone plus on top.
block.frontiers.enchanting_magnet.tip: Picks up nearby Experience Orbs and stores a fraction of their value. Stored experience can be collected with Glass Bottles.
block.frontiers.item_vacuum.tip: Picks up nearby items within a small radius. Placing an item in an Item Frame above it will make it only pick up items of that kind.
block.frontiers.ancient_rose.tip: An ultra-rare blue flower, grown when an Ancient Rose Seed is planted. Can be used as decoration or to craft a bush.
block.frontiers.ancient_rose_bush.tip: A tall blue flower crafted from 4 Ancient Roses and a Rose Bush.
block.frontiers.rose.tip: A rare red flower obtained by shearing Rose Bushes. Can be used to craft red dye.
block.frontiers.violet_rose.tip: A violet flower, grown when bonemealing a Rose or Ancient Rose nearby one another. Can be used as decoration or to craft a bush.
block.frontiers.violet_rose_bush.tip: A tall purple flower crafted from 4 Violet Roses and a Rose Bush.
block.frontiers.mourning_gold_block.tip: A compact way of storing Mourning Gold.
block.frontiers.black_emerald_block.tip: A compact way of storing Black Emeralds.
block.frontiers.tower_bricks.tip: An extremely strong brick found in the mysterious white tower.
block.frontiers.mossy_tower_bricks.tip: An extremely strong moss-covered brick found in the mysterious white tower.
block.frontiers.nacre_bricks.tip: Baked from Shulker residue in a furnace.
block.frontiers.nacre_brick_wall.tip: A wall made of Nacre Bricks.
block.frontiers.tower_brick_wall.tip: A wall made of Tower Bricks.
block.frontiers.mossy_tower_brick_wall.t: A wall made of Mossy Tower Bricks.
block.frontiers.snow_dahlia.tip: A rare icy flower that can be used to craft light blue dye.
block.frontiers.fungal_daffodil.tip: An uncommon purple fungus that can be used to craft purple dye. Only grows on Mycelium.
block.frontiers.fungal_daffodil_block.ti: Can be used as decoration. Causes players and mobs to bounce when they jump on it.
block.frontiers.crimcone.tip: A rare red flower from the Nether that can be used to craft red dye. Only grows on Crimson Nylium.
block.frontiers.experiwinkle.tip: An extremely rare glowing flower found in Flower Fields and Meadows. Can be grown to harvest some experience.
block.frontiers.cragulstane.tip: A strong, warped stone that generates in the Crags. Can be used for construction.
block.frontiers.cragulstane_bricks.tip: Crafted from Cragulstane. Can be used for construction.
block.frontiers.cragulstane_brick_wall.t: A wall made of Cragulstane Bricks.
